Description: Track laying bulldozers and angledozers (self-propelled)
Special_Condition: Chartered Engineer Certificate (CEC) required if imported as used or second-hand; Heavy machinery safety declaration

Description: Front-end shovel loaders (self-propelled heavy earthmoving equipment)
Special_Condition: Emission compliance certificate required; CEC mandatory for second-hand units certifying >= 5 years residual life

Description: Hydraulic excavators with a 360 degree revolving superstructure
Special_Condition: Mandatory pre-shipment inspection certificate; Verification of chassis number and engine displacement

Description: Portable automatic data processing machines weighing not more than 10 kg (laptops and notebooks)
Special_Condition: BIS CRS registration mandatory under IS 13252 (Part 1): 2010; WPC ETA certificate required for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth

Description: Other digital automatic data processing machines containing CPU and input/output units in same housing
Special_Condition: Mandatory BIS CRO marking; DGFT import license required for refurbished or second-hand computing units

Description: Enterprise servers and standalone digital processing units
Special_Condition: BIS CRS registration required; Cryptographic hardware must comply with SCOMET dual-use notification

Description: Hard disk drives and solid state storage units for data processing
Special_Condition: ITA-1 compliant duty-free rate; Concessional BCD subject to end-use declaration for manufacturing

Description: Other units of automatic data processing machines (memory cards and graphic accelerators)
Special_Condition: ITA-1 concession applicable; BIS safety compliance certificate

Description: Printed circuit assemblies and motherboards for automatic data processing machines
Special_Condition: Exempt from BCD under Information Technology Agreement (ITA-1); Traceability serial check

Description: Industrial robots specifically designed for automated lifting handling and welding
Special_Condition: Pre-shipment inspection certificate for industrial robotic safety; Dual-use SCOMET clearance if programmable on >= 5 axes

Description: Other machines and mechanical appliances having individual functions not specified elsewhere
Special_Condition: Manufacturer technical specification sheet and operation manual required at appraising

Description: Parts of machines and mechanical appliances having individual functions
Special_Condition: Bill of Materials (BOM) matching against parent machine model required

Description: Electric inverters and static converters for telecommunication and data networks
Special_Condition: BIS mandatory registration under IS 16242 (Part 1); Energy efficiency star rating labeling

Description: Industrial Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems and rectifiers exceeding 10 kVA
Special_Condition: Factory acceptance test report and harmonic distortion compliance certificate

Description: Network switches routers and packet transmission equipment
Special_Condition: Mandatory Testing and Certification of Telecom Equipment (MTCTE) by TEC; WPC equipment type approval

Description: Color monitors capable of directly connecting to automatic data processing machines
Special_Condition: BIS CRS registration mandatory; BEE energy efficiency declaration required

Description: Solar photovoltaic cells assembled into modules or panels
Special_Condition: Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) compliance; Basic Customs Duty subject to safeguard duty check

Description: Electronic integrated circuits: Processors and controllers with clock and timing circuits
Special_Condition: Zero BCD under ITA-1; SCOMET Category 8 evaluation for high-performance military/aerospace rating

Description: Electronic integrated circuits: High-speed DRAM and Flash semiconductor memories
Special_Condition: Zero BCD under ITA-1; High-tech import monitoring system (CHIMS) registration

Description: Optical fibre cables for telecommunications and optical data transmission
Special_Condition: Anti-Dumping Duty check for specified originating origins; Technical tensile strength test report
